'''HE Grenade Tower''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|<b>ATK</b>: {{Color|5585|7}}
<b>Attack Interval</b>: {{Color|3|7}}s

<b>Attack Range</b>: {{Color|12.5|7}} meters

<b>Mode of Attack</b>: Attacks enemies by launching Mk Ⅱ grenades along a ballistic trajectory that detonate above ground near enemies. The grenade explosion deals area of effect {{Color|Heat DMG|3}} and leaves a burning zone that deals DMG to enemies within it.
|A launcher of compressed high explosive (HE) Originium grenades. This facility deals more devastating area damage compared to its standard counterpart.}}
